source.title: MongoDB Atlas Administration API
source.mutability: The vendor-hosted URL is mutable. Generation fails closed unless the bytes and SHA-256 match this reviewed contract.

contract_gaps.reason: The response has two correlated top-level arrays. The gateway can merge only one result_path, so automatic paging would silently discard or de-correlate shapes metadata.

auth.selected: OAuth2 service-account bearer access token supplied only by the enrolled mongodb_atlas connection
auth.official_documentation_model: OAuth2 client-credentials service accounts recommended; one-hour bearer access token; legacy HTTP Digest API keys also documented but unsupported by this pack

source_decision.reason: Atlas projects are infrastructure tenancy and billing containers, while clusters, migrations, backups, searches, and stream processors are managed runtime resources rather than canonical user work. The OpenAPI does not prove a durable user-work entity version plus deletion/tombstone contract for a task, note, or project mirror.
